discussion.body:
This is the shared acceptance ledger for eight long-running programs moved out of the issue queue on 2026-10-17. **Eight programs remain pending; none is accepted complete.** Administrative issue closure does not establish delivery or waive any requirement.

The original issue bodies and comments remain binding. The checklists below summarize their completion conditions without narrowing them. Record evidence, decisions, ownership changes and the next action here. Check a condition only against linked, reviewable evidence; retain failed, refused and contaminated controls. Preserve existing implementation ownership and inspect active work before allocating a new task.

The issue-resolution coordinator has an hourly recurring continuation to reconcile this ledger with verified progress. Hardware access, external approvals and genuine human acceptance remain explicit prerequisites. The Rust sweep charter is also tracked here; its work-package and defect issues retain their own implementation evidence and owner ledgers.

Original scope: [#7654](https://github.com/LTplus-AG/ifc-lite/issues/7654). **Pending** (`pending_hardware_cohort`).

Ownership: shared-account assignment; session must be confirmed before implementation.

- [ ] FZK twice and Snowdon twice: all four healthy, repeat true for both fixtures
- [ ] Committed receipt/per-sample/summary evidence with real select/hover/Lens deltas
- [ ] Separate native forced-device-loss recovery run through recorded command
- [ ] Perf ledger verdict

Next action: Reuse native-count-driver with canonical load, pinned source/build/fixture/Chrome and idle physical host. Run separate command-recorded forced-loss recovery; do not pool recovery into healthy samples.

Completion evidence: none accepted in this migration. Existing source-issue evidence remains available at the original link.

## #7670: Charter: Rust maintainability sweep (review 2026-10-15)

Original approved scope: [#7670](https://github.com/LTplus-AG/ifc-lite/issues/7670), every original section and approval remains binding. **Pending** (`pending_rust_sweep_stop_line`). Administrative migration of the umbrella issue changes its tracking location; it does not satisfy its definition of done, reject findings, defer required work or approve a PR.

Canonical source handoff: [immutable HANDOFF](https://github.com/LTplus-AG/ifc-lite/blob/7a44f548f67a7e57f510ecf0e79150267a4a7971/rust-review/handoff/HANDOFF.md), [622-ID ledger](https://github.com/LTplus-AG/ifc-lite/blob/7a44f548f67a7e57f510ecf0e79150267a4a7971/rust-review/ledger.csv), [decisions D1–D80](https://github.com/LTplus-AG/ifc-lite/blob/7a44f548f67a7e57f510ecf0e79150267a4a7971/rust-review/ledger.md), and all eight design notes in that archive. The original archive is preserved. [Successor reconciliation](https://github.com/LTplus-AG/ifc-lite/tree/f30f3f37c6dae9b81408e2d08bce817a3def7a50/rust-review/handoff/successor-reconciliation) distinguishes stale original statuses, scoped verified claims and unresolved work; it does not assert 622 completed dispositions.

- [ ] Every one of the original 622 IDs has an evidence-backed disposition: `fixed` with PR, `fixed-by:<ID>`, `rejected` with evidence, `wontfix` with the required recorded decision, or an explicit `deferred` disposition only where D8 permits it. Optional eligibility alone is not a disposition. Preserve one work-package mapping per ID and all required work.
- [ ] Complete the original required stop line: Phases S, B and F, C1–C4, C6, C7 and C9, including each approved design note's required consumer migrations. Record any actual optional remainder and maintainer decisions under D8; preserve accepted geometry debt exactly as recorded, without expanding it.
- [ ] All original prevention gates in §6 are present and invoked on main, and all claimed single homes in documentation/comments are true or removed. Preserve current ratchets and their scanner helpers during integration.
- [ ] Exact published/integrated trees meet the original R/X/G evidence, source-matched corpus/output/diagnostic and format oracles, feature/Python/WASM/parity/determinism requirements where applicable, independent adversarial review, current required host checks and measured base/branch performance requirements. Historical author reports and a passing earlier tree do not qualify a later tree.
- [ ] Resolve or evidence-refute retained support findings: merged C6 conflict-membership work growth and IFCX shared-parent emission, D47 shared-Pset budget charging, typed-slot wrong-known-target panic, F4 trivia/fold handling, and SERVER-26 material-name allocation before budgeting. Keep the exact receipts linked from [successor handoff comment](https://github.com/LTplus-AG/ifc-lite/issues/7670#issuecomment-6241985157). Source reviews without execution remain labelled as such.
- [ ] Finish/reconcile transferred unpublished work and validation: F3b #7779 (published stack plus recovered P1/P2/P4/E1), C2 #7781 (corrected stack plus required 5–8/X1), C4 #7782 (restored 4b and remaining required phases), F4 #7778, and required D47 PR #7895 even though #7783 auto-closed. Preserve patches/bundles, exact pins, live job ownership and the recorded missing F4 bundle-head gap. The three newly identified recovered F3b consumer/strict-validation/repeated-walk defects stay required next-stage work.

Ownership: successor coordinator bc9e57fa owns this tracking reconciliation and released F3b/C2/C4 lanes. Existing C6/D47 and F4 reviewers retain their active lanes until released. Recovered P1/P2/P4/E1 code is already present and is being corrected in a separate isolated implementation; do not reimplement it or duplicate the published-stack owner. Work-package issues and PRs carry concrete implementation acceptance; this umbrella ledger retains the full campaign stop line.

Next action: finish the running exact-source qualifications and corrected ordered prefixes, integrate only qualified/reviewed trees, preserve all finding dispositions and proof links here, and continue the remaining required slices. Ordinary independent builds/tests may run in parallel on the reachable Pop and PC workers; only actual timed performance cohorts require idle-host exclusivity. No acceptance completion is claimed by this migration.


### Scoped delivery update — 2026-10-18

Four scoped fixes have landed with their current-head required checks passing: [#7916](https://github.com/LTplus-AG/ifc-lite/pull/7916) repairs the shared viewer CI blockers; [#7905](https://github.com/LTplus-AG/ifc-lite/pull/7905) preserves property classes in JSON-LD; [#7909](https://github.com/LTplus-AG/ifc-lite/pull/7909) preserves folded relationships across legal STEP trivia and malformed suffixes; and [#7894](https://github.com/LTplus-AG/ifc-lite/pull/7894) corrects hierarchy ownership and edited material reveal. The retained F4 trivia/fold finding is concretely resolved by #7909, with the original baseline failing the assertion, the corrected implementation passing, and final required CI passing. Other retained findings above remain required. #7890's original reported incident remains open because its private event stack/model/cause is still unproven.

The existing C2-7 P1–P5 qualification completed its ten workspace/clippy commands: each prefix reports 5,492 passed, zero failed and 47 existing ignored tests, plus the exact workspace/all-target clippy command. This is scoped native gate evidence only; full R/corpus, consumers, WASM/Python, performance and publication obligations remain pending. No prefix was republished or accepted on this evidence alone.

[Durable checkpoint and receipts](https://github.com/LTplus-AG/ifc-lite/tree/66c45cea55a8219da64f51b64a1ae52ad633b0c6/rust-review/handoff/successor-reconciliation) preserve the original 622-ID ledger and requirements. All eight programs and all 33 acceptance conditions above remain pending; no acceptance box is checked by this update.


### Further delivery and one completed smoke defect — 2026-10-18

Following the scoped update above, [#7912](https://github.com/LTplus-AG/ifc-lite/pull/7912), [#7907](https://github.com/LTplus-AG/ifc-lite/pull/7907), [#7898](https://github.com/LTplus-AG/ifc-lite/pull/7898) and [#7922](https://github.com/LTplus-AG/ifc-lite/pull/7922) have also landed with all four current-head required checks passing. #7912 makes native/browser A/B reporters refuse incomplete comparisons and retain undefined zero-baseline verdicts; #7907 adds the positional-scanner canary; #7898 fences renderer admission to the current GPU lifetime. The original #7655 spontaneous-loss cause and contamination-rate requirements remain open.

[#7919](https://github.com/LTplus-AG/ifc-lite/issues/7919) is now completed through #7922: its real AC20-FZK-Haus JSON IDS/rules/document journey passed in 20.5 seconds, preserving the original IDS locator, native audits/dry runs and save/handoff assertions. All six successful screenshots were retained and the downloaded artifact digest matched GitHub. This is one concrete smoke-journey defect closure, not broader AI program acceptance. #7890 and #6516 remain unresolved original incidents.

[Updated durable receipts](https://github.com/LTplus-AG/ifc-lite/tree/27e5a6bb43206a4f899260ad9177c726b501ab86/rust-review/handoff/successor-reconciliation) preserve all earlier evidence and the original 622-ID/D1–D80/design-note obligations. All eight programs and all 33 acceptance conditions remain pending; this update checks none of their boxes.


**C4 corrected-prefix native checks completed — 2026-10-18**

The exact corrected r2/r3/r4 prefixes now pass native workspace (5479/5479/5480 passed, respectively; zero failures and47 ignored each), exact all-target workspace Clippy, five source gates each, and the unchanged56-case native output/event/diagnostic corpus against retained base61. The ownership-only mutation produced the expected allocation-pointer assertion failure; exact restoration and both parsed positive tests passed. These are scoped native results, with declared timer/point-cache normalization retained. Existing native zero/noise, six IR failures and seven browser TOTAL failures remain binding. Corrected consumers/artifacts, cross-platform qualification, performance, current-main dependency integration and publication are still pending; no program condition is checked or issue closed by this update. The existing C4 owner is preparing only changed-prefix native/phase-marker/source-WASM artifacts; no new timed cohort is authorized here.

[Durable exact-pin receipts and remaining allocation](https://github.com/LTplus-AG/ifc-lite/blob/367dbe6f41cc58c3de336ea7daed2416dd7b8968/rust-review/handoff/successor-reconciliation/c4-three-prefix-native-complete-2026-10-18T141823Z.json).


### Python public-help correction landed — 2026-10-19

[#7932](https://github.com/LTplus-AG/ifc-lite/pull/7932) landed after all four required checks and exact-head review. It corrects the Python property dictionary documentation, reference-label fallback and single-value type tags. A source-matched wheel passed the compiled-help test with all 11 examples, including the real C6 nominal type tag; exact workspace Clippy passed. The merged tree exactly matches the validated head. [Merge and validation receipts](https://github.com/LTplus-AG/ifc-lite/blob/dba7f8aab343251eb449e0d5e44fb42f0f4fb593/rust-review/handoff/successor-reconciliation/d47-python-doc-pr7932-merged-2026-10-18.json) retain the earlier causal inverse and its scope.

The separate D47 shared-set budget implementation remains unaccepted. Its exact raw source passes all 68 Python tests with zero skips/errors ([Python receipts](https://github.com/LTplus-AG/ifc-lite/blob/018c04e5c3a691ad700382506d5b24e11e11c558/rust-review/handoff/successor-reconciliation/d47-raw-python-consumer-2026-10-19.json)). Official WASM build and type synchronization pass; package tests report 21 passed, root contracts 212 passed with one optional historical-baseline skip, and the wasm32 mesh manifest passes. The actual public property witness passes 13 groups plus seven-class and ambiguity controls. [WASM receipts](https://github.com/LTplus-AG/ifc-lite/blob/e4c6b3f5e22e502a9e312b9d05a03841e8b5175e/rust-review/handoff/successor-reconciliation/d47-raw-wasm-consumer-2026-10-19.json) preserve both earlier setup/witness failures, the corrected aggregate-pin harness, all 182 unchanged fixture identities and the bundle-size warning. The exact public02 baseline now builds and matches committed types; the saved candidate root contract passes 223 tests with zero failures or skips using that baseline. Its WASM grows by 4,093 bytes (+0.0418%); the existing size warnings remain. [Matched baseline receipts](https://github.com/LTplus-AG/ifc-lite/blob/a2bad162d67be73791c6fac23f922a3c12c6ea97/rust-review/handoff/successor-reconciliation/d47-public02-wasm-baseline-2026-10-19.json) bind all 39 verified artifacts (38 archived; the WASM binary remains local and hash-bound). These geometry contracts do not establish property-budget export parity. The source-matched API profiling executables, clock bridges and wheels now build successfully on both sides: 22 stages passed, and 127 artifact hashes were verified ([build receipts](https://github.com/LTplus-AG/ifc-lite/blob/757a5a491178dae22a4c3f3c89f31b85bb975efc/rust-review/handoff/successor-reconciliation/d47-public-api-profiling-builds-2026-10-19.json)). All 30 untimed output calls now pass, with all three semantic comparisons clear ([output receipts](https://github.com/LTplus-AG/ifc-lite/blob/7306054b641639be5bf56efe86852c4705c0e757/rust-review/handoff/successor-reconciliation/d47-untimed-profiling-outputs-2026-10-19.json)). Shared-set and opposed-order changes match the declared canonical corrections; all five complete Haus payloads are byte-identical. Canonical membership scope and inherited/own-property options remain explicit. The parent verified all 65 artifacts and independently decompressed/hash-checked all 30 original outputs. Actual Pop loading and all 150 performance calls remain unrun; the owner is idle with saved artifacts held for genuine admission. Pop recovery reclaimed 49.65 GiB of owned compiler intermediates with retained-file verification; eligible old test executables are being archived losslessly. No timed cohort is queued. Performance/RSS/first callback, current-main integration and publication remain pending. The prepared #7911 benchmark remains unsubmitted while Pop admission is blocked; no benchmark queue blocks builders. Other implementation ownership and original acceptance duties remain binding. All eight programs and all 33 conditions remain pending.
